pin_policy: Pinned to the schema bytes agent-plugins.org currently serves for this version, recorded here by sha256 and by the upstream commit they were taken from. CAO does not track upstream: re-vendoring is a deliberate act (`make refresh-agent-plugins-schemas`) that changes these hashes in a reviewable commit. A `make check-agent-plugins-schemas` failure therefore means the vendored bytes changed, NOT that upstream moved -- investigate the local change before updating the pin. Section 5.2 forbids retrieving a schema while loading a plugin, so these bytes are the only schemas CAO ever validates against.
